sentence_stem: He should have read the report carefully,
correct_completion: but he only skimmed the first page.
full_sentence: He should have read the report carefully, but he only skimmed the first page.
acceptable_variants: but he skipped most of it.
but he did not finish it.

options.text: so he knew all the details.
options.why_wrong: 'Should have' criticizes a missed past action; this option describes success, which contradicts the criticism.

options.text: and he is reading it now.
options.why_wrong: This describes a present action, but 'should have' refers to a past action that did not happen.

options.text: but he only skimmed the first page.
and he has already finished it.
options.why_wrong: This describes completion, which does not match the criticism of a missed careful reading.

grammar_focus: Modal perfect 'should have' for past criticism, with a contrasting clause
explanation: The modal perfect 'should have' criticizes a past action that was not done, so the continuation must show what actually happened in contrast.
translation: Ele deveria ter lido o relatório com atenção, mas só passou os olhos pela primeira página.
